categories.name: wallet
categories.evidence: Has the Wallet label and exposes replacement transaction fields in interfaces::WalletTx from wallet::CWalletTx.
categories.rationale: Exposes missing replacement transaction IDs on the wallet interface boundary needed by downstream consumers like the QML GUI. A prior commit removed value_map without re-adding explicit fields for replaces_txid and replaced_by_txid, leaving the interface incomplete for consumers tracking replacement transactions.
